title: Corona spy satellite program offered as explanation for Vallee's sighting

tellings.quote: sighting by invoking the Corona program, a series of highly secretive CIA-sponsored satellites first launched in 1960, kicking off the modern era of orbital espionage. The Corona satellites did have a nearly polar orbit. However, it's a very insufficient explanation.

related.note: Offers the CIA Corona spy satellites as the explanation for the same orbiting object in telling 3, which is a different core claim about what the light was.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recounts that a sighting by a researcher named Jacques Vallee, an object seen from the Paris Observatory moving in an unusual orbit, was explained away by pointing to Corona, a series of highly secret spy satellites backed by the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, first launched in 1960. Michels grants that the Corona satellites did travel in a nearly polar orbit, passing over the poles, but he calls it a very poor explanation. If he is right, Vallee saw something in orbit that nobody has accounted for.
